interaction: On a fresh /new draft, before any other change, Insert > Image > Upload from computer with a PNG
why: A seller who opens a new deck and puts the customer logo on it first gets a store error and no picture; the deck has no server record until another write creates it.

interaction: Insert > Image > By URL with an https PNG on a host outside the capture allowlist (raw.githubusercontent.com), then Insert
why: Production fetches pictures only from generaltranslation.com, prototemplate.com, glyphfield.com and Wikimedia (HOSTED_ALLOW_HOSTS), so a customer logo URL is refused, and the message tells a seller to pass a CLI flag.

interaction: Insert > Image > By URL with an https PNG on an allowlisted public host (upload.wikimedia.org), then Insert
why: The one public host on the allowlist answers the server's fetch with HTTP 403, so no URL a seller is likely to paste works; the dialog stays open with the error.

interaction: Insert > Image > By URL with an https PNG on the company domain (generaltranslation.com, allowlisted) on a slide that already holds a positioned picture, then Insert
shots: run-4/01-transparency.png (the refused write card over the editor)
why: The dialog's block.insert sends a shot without a position box, the canvas layout refuses it, the picture never appears, a card titled A change was not applied shows the mutation JSON, the title row reads Couldn't save, retrying, and every click is blocked until Dismiss; the fetched asset stays in the deck as an orphan.

interaction: Insert > Image > By URL with an https PNG on the company domain, as the first object on a content slide that is not a canvas yet, then Insert
why: The picture lands as a flow block in the slot after 7.6 s and the slide keeps its layout; the dialog was still open when the block appeared and closed on Escape, and a second Insert adds a second copy.

interaction: Insert > Image > Upload from computer, a PNG through the file chooser, on a slide with the room connected
why: On two of three decks the file chooser opened and the picture landed in 1.5 to 4.2 s; on the third the server accepted the asset (the response carries it) but the editor never received the write, no block was inserted, and every later asset.add on that deck was refused as stale (baseRevision 1 is stale; the document is at revision 2) with no message to the seller.

interaction: Drag a PNG file from the desktop and drop it on the slide (the drop dispatched with a DataTransfer built in the page, Playwright's file drop pattern)
why: The drop lands the picture at the drop point when the previous write has settled; while a write is still pending the editor stamps the picture with the document revision, the store is one ahead, the write is refused (baseRevision 2 is stale; the document is at revision 3) and nothing tells the seller.

interaction: Copy a PNG to the clipboard and press Cmd V on the slide
why: Paste inserted the picture at the content origin on two decks and failed silently on the deck whose revision had gone stale; the same asset.add path as upload and drop.

interaction: The toolbar Image button opens the image sources
why: The button lists Upload from computer, By URL and From this presentation, the same rows as Insert > Image.

interaction: Type a URL into the Image by URL field at human speed
evidence: The dialog's live preview img takes every partial address as the URL is typed: run 2 logged 151 console entries Failed to load resource: net::ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED for https://r/, https://ra/, https://raw/ and so on, and 18 HTTP 429 answers from POST /api/x/csp/report (the CSP report endpoint rate limiting the violation reports those requests raise); run 6 logged 144 console entries of the same kinds.
why: Cosmetic for the seller, but every keystroke is a request to a host that does not exist and a burst of CSP reports that the server then rate limits.

why: The chip reads Image, the eight resize handles and the rotation ring appear, and the toolbar tail shows border, crop, replace, Image options, reset and dither controls.

interaction: Select a picture and press Delete
why: The block left the slide on every try where the click selected the intended picture.

interaction: Drag the picture so its centre comes within 3 px of the slide's vertical centre line (x 800)

why: Crop mode opened with the chip Crop and eight crop handles.

why: The frame shortened by 60.

why: The trim was written, the box shrank to the frame and the sheet shows the kept part.

why: The trim left and the box returned to its size before the crop.

why: The crop returned.

interaction: Format > Image > Crop image enters crop mode; Escape leaves it
why: The row was enabled with the picture selected, crop mode opened and Escape closed it without a write.

interaction: The toolbar Crop image button enters crop mode; a west edge drag, then Escape
why: The button opened crop mode; Escape committed the edge drag the same way Enter does, so there is no way to cancel a crop in progress other than Undo afterwards.

interaction: The toolbar Image options button opens the panel
why: The panel opened with the Picture, Adjustments and Dither sections; production has no Recolor or Reflection control.

interaction: Drag the Transparency slider to about 40 percent
why: adjust.transparency 0.4 was written and the picture's opacity on the sheet became 0.6; the slider sits below the fold of the panel at 900 px, so it has to be scrolled into view first (run 2's drag missed it).

interaction: Drag the Brightness slider to about 70 percent
why: adjust.brightness was written and the picture's filter changed.

interaction: Recolor a picture
why: Production carries no Recolor control; the Adjustments section holds Transparency, Brightness and Contrast.

interaction: Adjustments > Reset clears the transparency and brightness
why: The adjust field cleared and the picture's opacity returned to 1.

interaction: The toolbar Dither button
why: The button dispatches picture.dither without the slide or block ids; the snackbar reads picture.dither: invalid input at /slideId: Invalid input: expected string, received undefined and nothing is written; the same field written through the window API draws the screen, so the action works and the control is wired without its input.

interaction: Format > Image > Dither
why: The menu row fails the same way as the toolbar button: the action is sent without its input.

interaction: The same write through the window API (picture.dither with the Photograph preset)
why: The dither field landed and the dither canvas drew over the picture, which isolates the defect to the toolbar and menu wiring.

interaction: Format options > Dither: switch the preset to Neutral
why: The preset chip rewrote the dither field.

interaction: The toolbar Dither button again, to turn the screen off
why: The field stayed as it was; the same dead control as turning it on.

interaction: Format > Image > Reset image with a cropped picture
why: The row was enabled once the picture carried a trim, and the trim left; the box kept the cropped size.

interaction: Right click the picture > Replace image > By URL with a PNG on the company domain, then Replace
why: The asset changed from the 640 by 400 upload to the 1200 by 630 fetch and the box stayed at 560,300 480x300, so the layout survives; with a host the server refuses (run 2, Wikimedia 403) the picture stays as it was.

interaction: The toolbar Replace image button > Upload from computer, a PNG through the file chooser
why: Six tries on two decks all left the old picture: the replace stamps asset.add with the document revision while the store is one ahead (baseRevision 30 is stale; the document is at revision 31, shown raw in the snackbar), so swapping a customer logo by upload does not work.

interaction: Slide > Change background, pick a colour swatch, Done
why: slide.background took the swatch and the sheet's .slide-bg layer painted it; twelve palette swatches and a hex field are offered.

why: The dialog opened from the toolbar.

interaction: Change background > Choose image > By URL with a PNG on the company domain
why: The dialog inserts a shot without a position box instead of the covering picture object, the canvas refuses it and the same refused write card appears; no background picture lands.

interaction: Change background > Choose image > Upload from computer through the file chooser
why: On one deck the picture object covered the sheet at 0,0 1600x900 at the bottom of the stack; on another every try was refused as stale while a write was pending, the same asset.add mechanism as the insert paths.

interaction: Change background > Dither toggle over the covering picture

interaction: Change background > Remove picture
why: With a covering picture present the control appears and removes it; without one the control is absent.

interaction: Change background > Reset to theme, Done

run-6/07-present.png (run 6: the replaced company picture on the ink ground)
